fields.claim_quote:
CLAIM 1 : Given an integer k≤n and a graph G on n vertices, let A denote its 
adjacency matrix, and UA the strictly upper triangular matrix extracted from A. 
Then G  contains a maximum independent set of size k if and only if (UA)n-k+1=θ.
fields.explanation: The ordered path 1–2–3 has maximum independent-set size2 and an increasing length-two walk. Mathlib SimpleGraph.IsIndepSet and Matrix powers now establish the actual upper adjacency matrix entry (1,3)=1.
fields.flaw: For a graph G on n vertices whose maximum independent-set size is k, the strictly upper-triangular part UA of its adjacency matrix satisfies (UA)^(n-k+1)=θ, and conversely.
fields.problem: Title: An algorithm for solving the Independent Set problem
